title: Employees Cost of Living Relief Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Employees Cost of Living Relief Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 1985
ACT XIV OF 1985
EMPLOYEES COST OF LIVING (RELIEF) (AMENDMENT), ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act,
1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called Employees' Cost of Living (Relief)
(Amendment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Employees Cost of Living Relief Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Act I of 1974

ACT XIV OF 1985
ACT XIV OF 1985
EMPLOYEES COST OF LIVING (RELIEF) (AMENDMENT), ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act,
1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 3, Act
I of 1974.--In the Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1973 (I of 1974), in
section 3,-
(a) in subsection (5), in the Explanation,
after the word "subsection" the words, brackets and figure "and
subsection (6)" shall be inserted ; and
(b) after subsection (5), amended as
aforesaid, the following new subsection shall be added, namely :-
"(6) In addition to the cost of living
allowance admissible under for subsections (1), (2), (3) and (4), or, as the
case may be, subsection any, every employee whose wages do not exceed one
thousand five hundred rupees shall, in respect of his employment on or after the
first appearing;
has been announced and become effective on or
after the ninth day of January, 1984 ; and
(b) against the amount payable under an
agreement or settlement Leached and in force on the first day of July, 1985,
under which employees get increases at regular intervals on the basis of a rise
in the cost of living:
Provided further that the provisions of section 7 shall
not apply to the increase in wages payable under this subsection.".
